usage: Commonly used for plants that live in water or stay fully/submerged in an aquarium, pond, or wetland setting.
It often appears in gardening and fish-tank vocabulary, especially when talking about decoration, water quality, or habitat.
Usually uncountable in everyday use; if you need to be specific, you can use a measure word or say a kind/portion of 水草.
Natural in both casual and practical contexts, but in aquarium talk it may refer to either real aquatic plants or decorative plants for tanks.
